date.as_written: śrīsamvat 1935 sāla miti mārga vadi 10 roja 4

notes: The colophon names no scribe, commissioner, owner or king. The only person named is the author, Gopālavilāsī. This could be an epithet or pen-name rather than a personal name. The date uses the Nepali formula 'saṃvat ... sāla miti ... roja', so the era is taken as VS (1935 VS ≈ 1878 CE). Read as NS, the year 1935 is impossible. The text after the date ('ntāgari || manalāi || ṣaicera ...') is a Nepali fragment of the work's text, not part of the scribal colophon.
